title: Aurora Watch
text:
🌌 Aurora Watch — October 31, 2026

Geomagnetic storm levels are active, and conditions are strong enough for Sunny to start an Aurora Watch.

🌎 Kp: 6.00 (G2 Storm Level)
🧲 IMF Bz: +5.4 nT (Northward)
💨 Solar wind: 551 km/s (Fast)
🚨 NOAA: ALERT: Geomagnetic K-index of 6
☀️ Solar driver context: CH-HSS

Look north tonight. 👀✨

Aurora visibility still depends on location, darkness, cloud cover, and how the magnetic field evolves from here. ✨

Image: NOAA SWPC — OVATION Aurora Forecast
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
